item.text: I’m extracting a field-iteration helper to remove the remaining copy-pasted grid scans from stats and rendering. That keeps traversal policy inside `Field` instead of reimplemented at each caller.

Refactored the grid model to use the domain type directly instead of raw objects. [Field.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R013_module_java/Field.java:12) now stores `Organism[][]`, `place(...)` accepts `Organism`, and `getObjectAt(...)` returns `Organism` plus typed overloads. That removes the last untyped storage seam from the core model and makes the field API match the rest of the refactored hierarchy.

I also pulled grid traversal into `Field` itself with `forEachLocation(...)`, then updated [FieldStats.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R013_module_java/FieldStats.java:113) and [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R013_module_java/SimulatorView.java:113) to use it. That eliminates duplicated row/column scan code and keeps iteration policy in one place.

Verification: `javac *.java` passes. I did not run the GUI simulation, so runtime behavior beyond compilation is still unverified.
